<module id="adder_pipe_64bit">
    <description>A 64-bit ripple carry adder implemented with pipelined registers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="i_en">Enable signal for initiating addition operation.</input>
        <input id="adda" width_description="[63:0]">First input operand for addition.</input>
        <input id="addb" width_description="[63:0]">Second input operand for addition.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[64:0]">Sum result of the addition operation.</output>
        <output id="o_en">Output enable signal indicating the availability of the result.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <!-- Pipeline Registers -->
    <reg id="i_en_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[0:0]">Register to store the input enable signal.</reg>
    <reg id="carry_in_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[0:0]">Register to store the carry-in value.</reg>
    <reg id="adda_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[63:0]">Register to store the first input operand.</reg>
    <reg id="addb_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[63:0]">Register to store the second input operand.</reg>
    <reg id="c_out_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[0:0]">Register to store the carry-out value.</reg>
    <reg id="s_out_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[63:0]">Register to store the sum output.</reg>
    <reg id="o_en_reg" type="flip_flop" width_description="[0:0]">Register to store the output enable signal.</reg>
    <!-- Intermediate signals for calculation -->
    <wire id="carry_in_next" width_description="[0:0]">Next carry-in value.</wire>
    <wire id="s_out_next" width_description="[63:0]">Next sum output.</wire>
    <wire id="c_out_next" width_description="[0:0]">Next carry-out value.</wire>
    <wire id="o_en_next" width_description="[0:0]">Next output enable signal.</wire>
    <!-- Sequential Logic Description -->
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Update registers on positive edge of the clock or negative edge of reset
        @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                i_en_reg <= 1'b0;
                carry_in_reg <= 1'b0;
                adda_reg <= 64'b0;
                addb_reg <= 64'b0;
                c_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                s_out_reg <= 64'b0;
                o_en_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                i_en_reg <= i_en;
                carry_in_reg <= carry_in_next;
                adda_reg <= adda;
                addb_reg <= addb;
                c_out_reg <= c_out_next;
                s_out_reg <= s_out_next;
                o_en_reg <= o_en_next;
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <!-- Combinational Logic Description -->
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Calculate next carry-in value
        assign carry_in_next = c_out_reg;
        
        // Perform addition operation
        assign {c_out_next, s_out_next} = adda + addb + carry_in_reg;
        
        // Determine output enable signal
        assign o_en_next = i_en_reg & !o_en_reg;
    </endlogic_description>
    <!-- Assign outputs to registered values -->
    <assign result = {c_out_reg, s_out_reg}; // Concatenate carry-out and sum output</logic_description></module>
